title: Common Sense Beyond English: Evaluating and Improving Multilingual Language Models for Commonsense Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the performance disparity of multilingual language models between English and up to 15 other languages on commonsense reasoning tasks, utilizing a zero-shot sentence-ranking probing task (MickeyProbe) and translated cross-lingual benchmark datasets (X-CSQA and X-CODAH).
